name: The Perfect Specimen
source:
You are Teagan, a Fae subject in an evil underground experiment run by the notorious mad scientist Doctor Dwight. Can you stay sane until help arrives? Or will you succumb to the Doctor’s dark experiments?

[From [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-perfect-specimen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Teagan，一名妖精族实验对象，正被臭名昭著的疯狂科学家Dwight博士用于邪恶的地下实验。你能保持清醒，撑到救援到来吗？还是会屈服于博士的黑暗实验？

[摘自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-perfect-specimen]itch.io[/url]]
